title: Payment failed when upgrading to Pro
body: Upgrade payments can fail when the card issuer declines the transaction, 3-D Secure verification is not completed, or the billing address does not match. Each failed or retried attempt may place a temporary authorization hold on the card. If the plan still shows Free after a successful charge, the Billing team must verify the payment and activate the subscription manually.

title: Duplicate or pending charges after a failed upgrade
body: Pending charges from failed or retried upgrade attempts are usually authorization holds, not completed payments. Only the Billing team can confirm which charges were captured and arrange reversals; support agents must not promise refunds or timelines. Customers considering a bank dispute should be told that a Billing specialist is reviewing their account.

title: What is included in the Pro plan
body: The Pro plan adds export to PDF and PPTX, unlimited projects, version history and priority email support. Pro features become available as soon as the subscription is active on the account.

title: Status page and reporting an outage
body: status.company.com shows the public status of each region. The status page can lag behind an incident that is still being investigated. If you cannot access the service, contact support with your region, the error code you see, and whether colleagues are affected. Enterprise customers are routed to the incident team immediately.

title: Troubleshooting HTTP 500 errors
body: An HTTP 500 error means the server failed to handle the request. If it appears for one user only, clear the browser cache and retry. If it appears across browsers, devices or for several colleagues, it is likely a service-side problem and should be reported as an outage.

title: Dark mode and appearance settings
body: Go to Settings > Appearance to choose a theme. Three options are available on all plans (Free, Pro and Enterprise) in app version 4.2 and later: Light, Dark and System Default. System Default follows your operating system's light or dark setting. Scheduled theme switching (for example at a set time of day) is not currently supported.

title: System Default theme does not follow my OS
body: After changing the operating system appearance, fully quit and reopen the desktop app so it picks up the new setting. If the app is on version 4.2 or later and still ignores the OS setting after a restart, report it to support with your app version and OS version so engineering can investigate.

title: How feature requests are handled
body: Feature requests are logged by support and reviewed by the product team. We cannot share release dates for requested features, but customers are notified if the feature ships.

title: Resetting your password
body: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page to receive a reset link by email. Links expire after 30 minutes. If you use SSO, reset your password with your identity provider instead.

title: Suspicious activity or a compromised account
body: If you suspect your account is compromised, reset your password immediately and enable two-factor authentication. Support escalates every suspected compromise to the Security team, who will contact you directly.

title: Exporting your workspace data
body: Workspace admins can export all projects as CSV or JSON from Settings > Workspace > Export. Large exports are emailed as a download link when ready.
